flags: The designation inventory supplies route sequence and designation dates, but no scenic rationale, road-building narrative, drive time or descriptions of curves and grades. Terrain detail is limited to the river towns; no unsupported countryside observations have been added.

Intro and moments run from the McLean County end toward the Muhlenberg County end, matching increasing supplied strip miles. Rosine lies on the inventory’s intervening loop between Dundee and Beaver Dam/Hartford and is not listed among the strip towns.

The 113.782-mile figure belongs to the original 2004 inventory entry, which separately records a 2007 US 231 addition without a total. It differs from catalog mapping of 110.5 miles. Inventory road labels include apparent OCR errors (U231, US 81 and eat); omitted those problematic turn-by-turn details.

Current claims have cache support. Dropped the unqualified “first case” description of Lincoln because the only account is a secondary summary; retained the narrower charge and dismissal. Omitted the barbecue superlative and precise Rosine event calendar because no site-manager confirmation is cached.

No opening hours or access guarantees are given. Rosine music is retained as a living practice; the store and barn are a listed historic landmark, not a replacement business stop. The Bill Monroe Museum page mixes a 2018 opening with unresolved construction language, so it was not used.
